prompt:
A real photograph, as a passer-by would take it with a good phone camera, of a
narrow street in central Madrid at eleven o'clock at night. The sky above the
rooftops is black, and warm streetlights and the glow of the ground-floor bars
light everything; the bars have plain glass fronts that
show only the warm light inside.

The young man of the reference picture, with his face, his hair, his grey zip
jacket, black T-shirt and blue jeans, stands in the middle of the pavement,
slightly left of centre in a vertical frame. The bottom edge of the picture
crosses his legs just below the knees. On the right of the picture, beside
his leg, rises the upper half of a silver hard-shell cabin suitcase, and his
hand nearer to it holds its pulled-out handle.
His face is turned towards the camera and his eyes look
sideways at the street around him, his mouth open in an amazed, delighted
smile.

All along both sides of the street, terraces of small round tables are full of
people eating and talking late at night, soft in the background blur. Above
them, old facades with wrought-iron balconies and green wooden shutters; the
bars have plain awnings in solid dark red and dark green. The textures of real
stone, iron, glass, fabric and skin.
